expectations.text: B1: Scaffolds the REPL milestone with TODOs and does not deliver pipes/redirection code yet
expectations.evidence: shell.c scaffold: 'TODO 1: read one line from stdin... /* your code here */ return NULL;' and 'TODO 2: split the line into tokens... /* your code here */ return NULL;'; lsh_execute is a stub ('Milestone 1 stub'); learner task stated: '你的任务：打开 shell.c，实现两个函数'. No pipe/redirection code anywhere — README lists them only as future milestones ('| 5 | Redirection |', '| 6 | Pipes |'), and 'Status: milestone 1 in progress.'

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Final answer ends with checkpoint: '验收命令：make && ./shell' plus expected behaviour: '输入 exit 回车 → 退出，echo $? 显示 0', '直接按 Ctrl-D → 干净退出', '空行回车 → 重新出现 > 提示符'

expectations.text: B3: Mentions reading a line, tokenizing it and exiting cleanly on EOF (Ctrl-D) / `exit`
expectations.evidence: 'shell 的本质是一个 REPL——读一行、切成参数、执行、循环'; 'EOF 时返回 -1（这就是 Ctrl-D 退出的信号）'; 'lsh_split_line() — 用 strtok() 按 LSH_TOK_DELIM 切'; '输入 exit 回车 → 退出' and '直接按 Ctrl-D → 干净退出'

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Only commands run: 'make 2>&1' and 'printf ... | ./shell; echo "exit status: $?"' — no install commands; files written are all in-project (Makefile, PROGRESS.md, README.md, shell.c, shell binary, shell.dSYM); agent noted '工作区是空的，macOS 上有 cc/make', asking learner only to '先 man 3 getline 看签名'
